channel.description: Recent content in Nature Education on Dipesh Dulal's Blog

item.title: School Herbal Garden of Resilience
item.description: Despite being a short-spanned, this project got attention of the school management and made them enthusiastic on having nature education projects at the school.

item.title: My kids love Oxalis latifolia Kunth
item.description: When it comes to comsuming Chari amili/amilo, I used my own childhood experience to make my kids savour few shoots of the herb once in a while.

item.title: Nature Activities for Kids
item.description: With this blog post, you may get ideas of some pragmatic nature activities that can be done with kids.

item.title: Collecting Common Vetch Pods (Kutuli Kosa): Outdoor Nature Activity with Kids
item.description: I have good memory of my childhood when we kids used to collect pods of common vetch popularly called as Kutuli Kosa (or Kutil Kosa) in Nepali. I (somehow) reproduced the same experience with my kids.

item.title: We collect Lamb's Quarters (Bethe ko Sag)
item.description: Bethe ko Sag (Lamb’s Quarters) can be promising alternative food for the world while Nepalese have been cooking it since eternity.
